title: Map targeted player draw to the now-supported player target

replaces_attempt.reason: Codex constrained could not begin its read-only proposal because the host bwrap sandbox denied loopback setup; no model proposal was produced.

source.parent_overlay: accepted Engine v2 proposal in the same disposable clone only

evidence.fact: p_draw maps target opponent and each opponent; target player was omitted solely because the old Engine could not represent a player target.
Engine v2 establishes {'filter': 'player'} as the Map-to-Engine boundary.
Tests use pathlib+sys.path, import reparse, and call reparse.O.parse_atom then reparse.map_atom.

required_behavior: Target player draws N cards. maps to ('draw', {'amount': N}, {'filter': 'player'}).
Target opponent draws N cards. and Each opponent draws N cards. retain ('draw', {'amount': N, 'target': 'opponent'}, None).
Each player draws N cards. and That player draws N cards. remain None.
The focused unittest uses reparse.O.parse_atom and reparse.map_atom with kind='oneshot'.
implementation_hint: Keep the opponent branch and add one target-player return before the final None.
gates: git status --porcelain adds only the two allowed Map paths relative to the accepted Engine child state
